title: Understanding Logistic Regression Output
text: In logistic regression, the output of the model is a probability. The sigmoid function, denoted as sigma, is used to map any real-valued number into the range of $$0$$ to $$1$$, which represents this probability.

title: Interpreting the Sigmoid Function
text: The sigmoid function, sigma, is defined as $$\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$, where $$z$$ is the input to the function. In the context of logistic regression, $$z$$ is typically the dot product of the feature vector and the parameter vector, theta.

title: Calculating Probability of Sadness
text: To find the probability of a tweet being sad, you need to consider the complement of the probability of it being happy. If $$\operatorname{\sigma}\left({\theta}^T x_{test}\right)$$ gives the probability of happiness, what would represent the probability of sadness?
